title: Immersion projection isomorphisms respect etale/pro-etale comparison
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite discrete commutative ring. Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (quasi-compact and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]), and fix a locally closed immersion $s:S\hookrightarrow X$ with factorization $S\xrightarrow{c}V\xrightarrow{v}X$, $c$ closed and $v$ open [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves on small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Put $Q_\tau=v_{\tau,!}c_{\tau,*}$ for $\tau=e,p$, using the exact functors of [lem-sf-derived-immersion-comparison-normalization]. Write $s_\tau^*=c_\tau^*v_\tau^*$ for constant-coefficient inverse image. Use the canonical derived tensor and monoidal pullback identifications [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback, lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons].

For all $D\in D(X_\tau,A)$ and $P\in D(S_\tau,A)$ there is a natural canonical projection isomorphism
$$\pi^\tau_{D,P}:D\otimes_A^LQ_\tau P\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_\tau(s_\tau^*D\otimes_A^LP).$$
It is the composite of the open projection isomorphism $D\otimes_A^Lv_{\tau,!}P'\cong v_{\tau,!}(v_\tau^*D\otimes_A^LP')$ for $P'=c_{\tau,*}P$ and $v_{\tau,!}$ of the closed projection morphism $D'\otimes_A^Lc_{\tau,*}P\to c_{\tau,*}(c_\tau^*D'\otimes_A^LP)$ at $D'=v_\tau^*D\in D(V_\tau,A)$. The latter is the ordinary $c_\tau^*\dashv c_{\tau,*}$ adjunction transpose of
$$c_\tau^*(D'\otimes_A^Lc_{\tau,*}P)\cong c_\tau^*D'\otimes_A^Lc_\tau^*c_{\tau,*}P\xrightarrow{1\otimes\varepsilon^\star_{c,P}}c_\tau^*D'\otimes_A^LP.$$
Here $\varepsilon^\star_c$ is the restriction/direct-image counit. The open map is inverse to the map obtained by transposing the open unit tensored with the other factor.

Write $C_T=\nu_T^*$ for exact site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact], $a_s:C_Ss_e^*\xrightarrow{\sim}s_p^*C_X$ for canonical pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], and $\Delta:C_XQ_e\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_pC_S$ on bounded-below objects for the composite of the specified closed counit-mate comparison and canonical open comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate, lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. If $D\in D^+(X_e,A)$ and $P$ is a degree-zero etale $A$-module sheaf with flat stalks, then $s_e^*D\otimes_A^LP$ is bounded below and the following square commutes:
$$Q_p((a_{s,D}\otimes1)\circ t_S)\circ\Delta_{s_e^*D\otimes_A^LP}\circ C_X(\pi^e_{D,P})
=\pi^p_{C_XD,C_SP}\circ(1\otimes\Delta_P)\circ t_X.$$
Here $t_T:C_T(U\otimes_A^LW)\xrightarrow{\sim}C_TU\otimes_A^LC_TW$ is the canonical tensor comparison. Both maps start at $C_X(D\otimes_A^LQ_eP)$ and end at $Q_p(s_p^*C_XD\otimes_A^LC_SP)$. No constructibility or exceptional right adjoint is used.

proof.text: The ordinary closed restriction/direct-image adjunction has invertible counit. Localize its exact functors termwise using exactDerivedAdjunction. The descended composite is isomorphic to the identity, so the derived right adjoint is fully faithful and its counit is invertible. Noetherianity of the ambient scheme supplies the local-Noetherian and compactness instances on the open subscheme.

source.place: Second paragraph, locally closed comparison: exact ordinary immersion operations and derived counits.

proof.text: For each site let U be the open complement of the closed stratum. Restriction to the stratum and to U jointly detects isomorphisms, also after exact descent to derived categories. Restricting c_*P to U is zero, by the disjoint-support vanishing theorem and exact homology comparison. Tensor pullback therefore shows that D tensor c_*P restricts to zero on U. The unit at this tensor is an isomorphism: its closed restriction is inverse to the invertible counit by the triangle identity, and its open restriction is a map between zero objects. The named closed projection is G of its invertible transpose after this unit, hence is invertible.

proof.text: Use the published native unbounded open projection isomorphisms, inverse to the specified open-unit transpose, and conjugate by the signed tensor symmetries. Compose this isomorphism with the open direct image of the named closed projection. Package both maps as transformations of bifunctors; their naturality in each variable gives exactly the simultaneous naturality formula.

source.place: Second paragraph, stratum Hom identification: compose the ordinary open and closed tensor projections.

proof.text: Flatness of every geometric stalk implies flatness of the sheaf by the existing stalk-flatness criterion. A flat sheaf in degree zero has Tor amplitude [0,0]. Exact pullback preserves a chosen lower bound n for D. The existing native-tensor Tor-amplitude lower bound, followed by signed symmetry, shows that s^*D tensor P has the same lower bound.

source.place: Second paragraph, applying comparison to the stratum tensor: verify the bounded-below domain of the ordinary direct-image comparison.

proof.text: Transport the published left-derived tensor comparisons through the exact/left-derived normalization isomorphisms. Naturality proves that this transport commutes with composition and with tensor symmetry. Apply the existing monoidal square theorem to the ordinary canonical pullback-comparison isomorphism. This yields ComparisonCompatible for the exact pullbacks and the precise comparisonTensor used in the statement.

source.place: Second paragraph, specified internal-Hom map: closed projection comparison before taking its transpose.

proof.text: The ordinary lowerStarComparisonUpperStarBaseChange is the mate of the ordinary inverse-image square by derivedImmersionClosed_sheaf_transpose. The exact_mate normalization identifies the termwise descended closedComparison with the mate of pullComparison. Apply map_rightAdjointProjectionMap_comp_mateEquiv to the flipped tensor bifunctors and the compatibility established in step 5. This is precisely the closed projection square.

source.place: Second paragraph, named comparison map: the closed square follows by expanding the two ordinary counit transposes.

proof.text: Invert the existing openProjectionTransport_projection_square using cancellation by its two projection isomorphisms. Move the exact/left-derived restriction normalizations through the tensor comparison by naturality. Conjugate the resulting square by the signed symmetries; their compatibility with comparison from step 5 gives the forward openProjection square with the ambient factor first.

source.place: Second paragraph, locally closed comparison: normalized open tensor square with its inverse.

proof.text: Expand projection and extensionComparison into their open and closed factors. Naturality of the open comparison moves the closed projection into its direct image. Insert the closed square, use naturality of the pro-etale closed projection along a_v, then insert the open square. Naturality in the stratum input moves delta_P through that projection. Functoriality of tensor identifies the composite a_c followed by c_p^*(a_v) with immersionPullComparison, giving the stated square for every unbounded D,P. Specialize P to the single sheaf and combine with step 4.

source.place: Second paragraph, the stratum Hom identification and specified internal-Hom map: paste the two normalized projection squares.
